sections.Profile:
The Devil Riders pinball machine, released by Zaccaria in 1984, features a thrilling stunt motorcycle theme. It boasts two playfields—one of which is transparent—and six flippers, including two reactive flippers that help flip the ball back into play from the outlanes.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1984
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Backbox Gimmick, Original Theme, Solid State, Upper Playfield, Motorcycles, 1980s
